name: weather_convert_time
description: Convert a datetime from one timezone to another. Returns a JSON payload with the original and converted timestamps and the time difference in hours. Accepts 'now' or ISO 8601 input (including trailing 'Z').

arguments.name: datetime_str
arguments.desc: Datetime to convert. Either the literal string 'now' (case-insensitive, whitespace allowed) or an ISO 8601 datetime (e.g. '2026-03-28T14:30:00', '2026-03-28T14:30:00Z', or '2026-03-28T14:30:00+02:00'). Strings without an offset are interpreted in ``from_timezone``.

name: weather_get_air_quality
description: Get compact air quality information for a city. Returns agent-friendly JSON text with current conditions, summary statistics, and a short hourly sample. Use this for concise analysis. Includes selected location, UTC model timestamps, valid/missing coverage and provider-computed US AQI subindices.

arguments.name: city
arguments.desc: City name in English, optionally with region/country to disambiguate.

arguments.name: variables
arguments.desc: Optional subset of pollutant variables to query. If omitted, the default compact set is used: pm10, pm2_5, ozone, nitrogen_dioxide, carbon_monoxide. Pass an explicit list when the user asks for a specific pollutant (e.g. ['ozone']) or wants to exclude one.

name: weather_get_air_quality_details
description: Get detailed air quality data for a city as structured JSON text. Use this tool when downstream logic needs raw API-like fields in 'full_data'. Preserves all upstream arrays; adds location, temporal coverage and provider-computed US AQI (weather://aqi).

arguments.name: city
arguments.desc: City name in English, optionally with region/country to disambiguate.

arguments.name: variables
arguments.desc: Optional pollutant list. If omitted, the extended default set is used: pm10, pm2_5, ozone, nitrogen_dioxide, carbon_monoxide, sulphur_dioxide, ammonia, dust, aerosol_optical_depth.

name: weather_get_by_range
description: Get weather data for a city between two calendar dates (inclusive). Returns a compact JSON payload optimized for agent analysis, including period metadata, summary statistics, and an hourly sample. Forecast window: UTC today-92 through today+15 days; default maximum 16 days inclusive. sample_mode selects first/last/spread (up to 12 rows); coverage separates past/present and future model data.

arguments.name: city
arguments.desc: City name in English, optionally with region/country to disambiguate.

arguments.name: start_date
arguments.desc: Start date in ISO 8601 calendar format: YYYY-MM-DD. Must be on or before end_date.

arguments.name: end_date
arguments.desc: End date in ISO 8601 calendar format: YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). The inclusive duration limit defaults to 16 days (see response schema resource). Forecast policy: today UTC minus 92 days through today UTC plus 15 days.

arguments.name: sample_mode
arguments.desc: Hourly sample selection: first, last or spread; at most 12 rows.

name: weather_get_current
description: Get a concise, human-readable snapshot of current weather for a city. Use this tool when you need a short summary (temperature, humidity, wind, precipitation context, pressure, clouds, UV, visibility), not raw datasets. Includes selected location and the nearest hourly model valid time in UTC.

arguments.name: city
arguments.desc: City name in English, optionally with region/country to disambiguate (for example: 'Springfield, US' or 'London, UK'). Control characters, excessive whitespace are stripped automatically; unsafe punctuation is rejected.

name: weather_get_details
description: Get detailed structured JSON weather data for a city. Use this when you need raw fields for downstream processing. Optionally include a short forecast window. Includes resolved location, model provenance, reference_time and UTC valid_time.

arguments.name: city
arguments.desc: City name in English, optionally with region/country to disambiguate.

arguments.name: include_forecast
arguments.desc: When true, attaches a 'forecast' array with the next 24 hours of hourly model data. Defaults to false for a smaller payload.

name: weather_get_time
description: Get the current local datetime for a specific IANA timezone. Returns structured JSON with timezone and ISO 8601 datetime.

arguments.name: timezone_name
arguments.desc: IANA timezone name (for example: 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'UTC'). Case-sensitive; must match the IANA database exactly. Refer to the ``weather://timezones`` resource for the curated list.

name: weather_get_timezone
description: Get timezone metadata for an IANA timezone as structured JSON: current local time, UTC time, offset in hours, DST flag, and timezone abbreviation. Use this when the user asks about DST, UTC offset, or abbreviation (e.g. 'PST', 'CET').

arguments.name: timezone_name
arguments.desc: IANA timezone name (for example: 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'Asia/Tokyo'). Refer to ``weather://timezones`` for the curated list.

name: weather_get_status
description: Check process liveness and server identity; upstream readiness is not checked.
